scope_rationale: Accessible corpus and T15.15 name compression; RLE alone does not implement prefix coding, match overlap or optimal parsing. Required comprehensive scope retains all three rather than treating historical or-choice as exclusion.

competencies.outcome: Derive and implement prefix coding, overlapping backwards matches and their bounded transactional composition.
Compare greedy and optimal token parsing under measured workloads, stack/storage bounds and precisely distinct objectives.
Construct independent prefix-space and shortest-path oracles; reject malformed frames and discriminating compiling mutants.

preservation: Refines active required coverage without rewriting accepted leaf text, hours or historical evidence.
